answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 3038 Country: India Title: In the first night I come to know that my wife had physical relation with anyone and she is not seemed ashamed for that.she was somewhat mentally abnormal also she lacks the qualities to be a faithful and good wife.Beside this I was not physically satisfied with her, but she was satisfied with me. Are these grounds are well enough to give her divorce? Question: In the first night I come to know that my wife had physical relation with anyone and she is not seemed ashamed for that.she was somewhat mentally abnormal also she lacks the qualities to be a faithful and good wife.Beside this I was not physically satisfied with her, but she was satisfied with me. Are these grounds are well enough to give her divorce? Answer ID: 3038 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 159/159/L) According to Shariah giving talaq (divorce) is not wajib (necessary) until the couples are in such a conflict in which they are unable to render their duties and obligations. Thus, the reasons mentioned above do not suffice for giving divorce: لایجب علی الزوج تطلیق الفاجرۃ ولا علیھا تسریح الفاجر الا اذا خافا ان لا یقیما حدود اللہ فلا باس ان یتفرقا ( الدر المختار مع الشامی: 4/144 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
